value.when: when you use the shrieking key to Pick a Lock

why: Re-authored from the overlay so the situationalReplaces flag can DERIVE. The applier derives that flag from decision-file rows, and this row had none — its decision file was lost — so it was the one record of the seven that could not self-heal when the broken key regex was fixed. Value unchanged; this exists purely to give the derivation something to read.
